title: Axentra
description: A powerful, lightweight Minecraft server management plugin with 40+ commands including full moderation, virtual block openers, weather, time and more.
body:
# Axentra
> A powerful, lightweight Minecraft server management plugin

## ⚔️ Moderation
- `/ban <player> [reason]` — permanently ban a player
- `/tempban <player> <duration> [reason]` — temporarily ban (e.g. `1d`, `7d`, `30m`)
- `/banip <player|ip> [reason]` — permanently ban an IP address
- `/tempbanip <player|ip> <duration> [reason]` — temporarily ban an IP
- `/unban <player>` — unban a player
- `/unbanip <ip>` — unban an IP address
- `/kick <player> [reason]` — kick a player
- `/mute <player> [reason]` — mute a player
- `/unmute <player>` — unmute a player
- `/warn <player> [reason]` — warn a player
- `/warns [player]` — view a player's warnings
- `/clearwarns <player>` — clear a player's warnings
- Ban appeal link shown on the kick screen
- Automatic punishments at set warn thresholds (kick, mute, tempban or ban)
- All bans and mutes stored persistently in SQLite

## 🎮 Player Commands
- `/fly [player]` — toggle flight
- `/heal [player]` — restore health and food
- `/feed [player]` — restore food level
- `/clear [player]` — clear inventory
- `/repair` — repair held item
- `/hat` — wear any item as a helmet
- `/ping [player]` — check latency
- `/suicide` — instantly kill yourself

## 📦 Utility
- `/workbench` — open a crafting table
- `/anvil` — open an anvil
- `/grindstone` — open a grindstone
- `/loom` — open a loom
- `/stonecutter` — open a stonecutter
- `/smithingtable` — open a smithing table
- `/cartography` — open a cartography table
- `/enderchest` — open your ender chest

## 🌍 World
- `/weather <clear|rain|storm>` — set the weather
- Aliases: `/sun`, `/sky`, `/rain`, `/storm`
- `/time <set|add> <value>` — set or add world time
- Aliases: `/day`, `/night`, `/noon`, `/midnight`

## ⚙️ Admin
- `/axentra reload` — live reload without restarting
- `/axentra upgrade` — check for updates via GitHub
- `/axentra information` — view plugin info
- `/help [page]` — paginated help menu filtered by permissions

## 🔧 Configuration
- Fully configurable `messages.yml` with prefix and color code support
- All announcements toggleable in `config.yml`
- Custom ban appeal link
- Configurable automatic warn punishments

## 📋 Requirements
- Spigot / Paper 1.21+
- Java 21+
